observations: Searched public GitHub repositories and inspected pinned commits, source files and direct LICENSE files.
Four useful mechanism-reference candidates were found; one archived project lacks a verified repository-level license.
The existing project already uses factory-owned spatial-shop-v1, Phaser, TypeScript and local QA tooling; no additional production dependency is needed for this research.
The same-stack shopkeepers-legacy LICENSE explicitly covers source code only, not its third-party art.
inferences: Small queue/inventory examples are more suitable references for this preview than importing a complete Unity simulator.
Reference mechanisms should become original implementation constraints and independent acceptance checks, not copied gameplay code or assets.
unknowns: No candidate was built or executed; source inspection does not demonstrate runtime correctness.
None of the candidates has been validated here for WeChat, Douyin or TapTap packaging.
Whole dependency trees, asset rights, security advisories and active maintenance quality were not audited.
queries: Local reusable infrastructure: factory spatial-shop-v1 and existing Phaser/TypeScript dependencies

candidates.name: CookieNoir/TA-Casual-Farm
candidates.license: MIT (source code; separate asset rights not approved)
candidates.technicalFit: Unity/C# small logistics game. Read queue positioning, head-arrival service gating, typed/capacity/cooldown inventory transfer and visible item handoff. Not directly importable into Phaser; no WeChat/Douyin/TapTap package verified.
securityRisks: Prototype last inspected commit is from 2023; tests/build and dependency vulnerabilities not audited.
README describes a clone exercise; names, presentation, models, audio and tuning are excluded regardless of root license.
attributionRequirements: The inspected MIT file requires retention of its copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
No code reuse is approved here; any separately licensed assets or dependencies require independent review.

rationale: This outcome means no direct-code-reuse candidate is approved, NOT that no useful references were found. Four candidates are REFERENCE_ONLY. Repository policy prohibits importing third-party game code/expression; retain the current engine and approved assets. This is a supplemental research artifact and does not replace the original pre-blueprint gate or authorize a build.
